verdict.rationale: Evidence shows users can destroy instances and volumes (which otherwise persist across instance destruction) via CLI/API, giving basic control over deletion of compute resources and data, but there is no explicit documentation of data retention policies, data-deletion guarantees, or privacy controls beyond simply terminating instances/volumes. missing for 10: explicit data retention/deletion policy docs, guarantees on backend data purge after deletion, account-level data deletion controls, independent verification of deletion behavior.
